segments.en: The verb to borrow and to lend.
Now this is a really important difference to make because many people make this mistake where they use the wrong verb.
segments.zh: 现在这是一个非常重要的区别，因为许多人在使用错误动词的地方犯了这个错误。

segments.en: Now if I ask you Marco, can I borrow your bicycle?
segments.zh: 现在如果我问你马可，我可以借你的自行车吗？

segments.en: That means can I take your bicycle from you and then later I'll give it back.
segments.zh: 这意味着我可以从你那里拿走你的自行车，然后我会把它还给我。

segments.en: But I want to use it.

segments.en: It's going on to you.

I want to borrow.
I want to take it from you for a short time and then I want to give it back.

segments.en: So to borrow.
Now the other verb is to lend and that on the other hand goes from me to you.
segments.zh: 现在另一个动词是借出，另一方面从我到你。

segments.en: So you borrow my bicycle.
segments.zh: 所以你借了我的自行车。

segments.en: I lend you my bicycle.

segments.en: I give it to you.

segments.en: That means can you act?

segments.zh: 所以有两种不同的表达方式，记住谁在做什么非常重要。

segments.en: Exactly.

segments.zh: 所以请记住，拿走的人是在借钱。

segments.en: The person giving is lending.

I want to borrow from you.

segments.zh: 这是一个人，一个句子中的主语。

segments.en: But in the case of lending, someone else is doing it.
segments.zh: 但在贷款的情况下，其他人正在这样做。

segments.zh: 正如你所说的，它被借给了谁。

segments.en: So the past tense of lend is lent.

segments.en: So one buck is one dollar.

segments.en: So if you borrow money, you have to pay it back.

segments.en: All right.

segments.en: Very good.
Okay.

segments.zh: 所以现在最后，我们会借钱，但我们当然需要保证。

segments.en: We need something to make sure that you will pay me back.
segments.zh: 我们需要一些东西来确保你会回报我。

segments.en: So that's called collateral.
All right.
Now collateral is important because sometimes you can't trust someone, like you say, Marco.
segments.zh: 现在抵押品很重要，因为有时你不能像你说的那样相信某人，马可。

segments.en: And so for example, if I want to rent a bicycle, so I want to use it for the day, maybe there's a store that they rent bicycles to people.
segments.zh: 所以比如，如果我想租一辆自行车，所以我想用它一天，也许有一家商店，他们会租用自行车给人们。

segments.en: I would give my passport or my driver's license as collateral because I will definitely return to take my driver's license or passport back.
segments.zh: 我会把我的护照或我的驾驶执照作为抵押品，因为我肯定会回来取回我的驾驶执照或护照。

segments.en: So that's basically a sign of a promise, money or identification or some object.
segments.zh: 所以这基本上是一个承诺、金钱或身份认同或某个对象的标志。

segments.en: That's right.

segments.zh: 因此，例如，通常，如果您要在银行获得一笔非常大的贷款，他们会向您索要一些作为抵押品的东西。

segments.zh: 所以你是说如果我不能还你，那么你可以夺走我的房子。
